notes.title: Weekly Balances and Fixes (1/31/2025)
notes.content:
To avoid spamming players with daily updates, I'll just add weekly changes to a single patch note to show what happened that week. 

[*]Fixed an issue where ghosts' speed were inconsistent when playing with Bravera. She was supposed to have ghosts' speed always be 100% more than their usual.
[*]Bravera's starting Projectile Range bonus brought down to 75% from 150%.
[*]Knockback reverted to not being able to push enemies past map boundaries. This is to further limit exploits done with Knockback, which is still very strong. Also improves performance.
[*]Fixed a pretty bad issue where frozen and stunned enemies would move when suffering from Knockback.
[*]Corrected The Shotty's damage tooltip. The Shotty now correctly inflicts Knockback, HP damage, and stunned damage (Assuming you select these bonuses in cards).
[*]Enemies will no longer spawn at extreme distances on Stage 2 (Middle Park), making it less common for unreachable pickups to drop.
[*]Projectile Range, Speed, Size and Melee Size are now capped at 150% due to it just being excessive and pushing the limits of the engine.
[*]'Mini Machine' and 'Futurist' cards allowed an exploit where any killed turrets would decrease your maximum tower count, allowing the player to build a huge amount of turrets.
[*]'Mini Machine' has been nerfed to only last 30 seconds. The relative ease that these Turrets could be spawned in late game would basically stutter or even crash the game due to load.
[*]Miasmis demons are more common after level 70 to increase difficulty, and now have more health.
[*]Big ghosts and big chargers can now spawn as elite after level 70.
[*]Higher ranked projectile demons have a higher chance to spawn after level 70.
[*]Higher ranked charger demons have a higher chance to spawn after level 70.
[*]'Fragile Ego' now will no longer display text if your bonus damage from it was 0.
[*]Hopefully fixed the issue of stray Enraged icons staying on screen on all Stages.
[*]Under the hood performance fixes.

notes.title: Dialogue Options and Bug Fixes (1/31/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Dialogue can now be toggled on and off in the options menu.
[*]Fixed an issue where some charging demons' attack indicators weren't disappearing after they died.
[*]Fixed an issue with displaced text on cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Penalizer Buff and other fixes (1/26/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Penalizer now has a new class type, 'Exterminator' - a class of heroes that has a modifier to their Ultimate (in this case quicker charging ultimate that has a lower cooldown, but is less powerful). He gains 5 Ultimate every time he levels up, in an attempt to make him stronger.
[*]Penalizing Grenades now have a higher scale multiplier when leveling up their damage. Rather than each card offering between 5-10% damage increase, the damage increase is now 10-20%.
[*]The tutorial on 'How to Play' now has an additional page explaining status effects.
[*]The Shotty's damage tooltip on the pause menu has now been fixed to accurately show its damage numbers.
[*]Stage boss' attacks will no longer be paused if the boss is frozen. Meaning that while frozen / stunned, the bosses can still initiate their attacks, but if they are frozen / stunned, their attacks will still play out, while previously they were simply paused.
[*]Triggering 'Lockdown' on bosses now has its duration affected by the enemy's elite rank. Before, it would initiate a long freeze on all enemies, including bosses.
[*]The font on the 'Futurist' Red Card is now bigger (was tiny before).
[*]The critical hit damage numbers caused by "Final Say" have been reduced from being way too big.
[/list]

notes.title: Performance Patch (1/25/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Optimization changes to help the game potentially run smoother with a crazy amount going on on screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Fixes (1/23/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Starspangled's Checker demons were overtuned.
[*]Levels past 60 will now have more variety of enemies and gradually increasing enemy difficulty.
[*]Fixed an issue with opacity of particle effects on certain weapons ignoring the player's opacity settings.[/list]

notes.title: Starspangled Nerf; Knockback Nerf; other changes (1/22/2025)
notes.content:
Due to a player finding out that Starspangled literally broke the game (as in almost making it crash), I realized both him knockback were so comically overpowered (and causing huge performance issues) that it was just removing the fun from the game, since the player could essentially stand there and kill everything without being touched once. There are several nerfs in this patch, which obviously will be subjected to change but for now make the game more balanced. There are also other changes

[*]Knockback now only affects enemies within 3 meters of the player. 
[*]Knockback can now only be inflicted by the player, not by anything that counts as a Turret.
[*]Knockback is now capped at 80%.
[*]Knockback has less of an effect on elite and boss enemies, the same as with damaging status effects (the higher the enemy’s rank, the less it will be affected).
[*]Starspangled now only gains 3% to basic damage types, rather than AOE, Melee and Explosive. He was able to stack insane amounts of damage on AOE + Explosive weapons, basically for doing nothing.
[*]Starspangled now has a permanent lock on his AOE / Melee size at -25%, making him more reliant on projectile weapons to knock enemies back.
[*]Starspangled’s Rivals and Checkers are now extremely powerful compared to other characters, making knocking them back essential to completing a run.

Other changes:

[*]Projectile Speed, Projectile Range, Projectile Size, AOE Size, Melee Size, have all been capped at 200%.
[*]Maxed out stats that have caps will now show when they are maxed on your Stats display.
[*]Yellow Card ‘Missed Leg Day’ now has a more extreme penalty, reducing your Health Recovery by 2.5% of your new Max HP.
[*]’Mini Machine’ now drops turrets with 20% of the main turrets’ HP, down from 50%.
[*]’Fresh Parts’ now has a 50% chance of giving +1 Turret Damage when picking up a material, rather than just +1 all the time.
[*]Magnet Demons now have higher health that scales off of your performance and pull your stuff quicker based on difficulty.
[*]Miasmis Demons now have higher health that scales off of your performance.
[*]Barrels from ‘Burner Phone’ now have a larger explosion to make them more punishing, and also have a sound when they explode now.
[*]’Burner Phone’ now has had its price raised to $1200, up from $800.

notes.title: Fixes (1/21/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Knockback has been slightly reworked to improve performance. It will only affect enemies under 5 meters from the player, as well as other under the hood changes.
[*]Purple Card 'Flagellator' has been slightly nerfed to give a range of possible bonuses, rather than guaranteed +1 Global Damage and +1% Cooldown Reduction.
[/list]

notes.title: Performance Patch (1/21/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved performance issues on chaotic runs caused by a high number of particles.
[*]Enemies can now no longer be knocked back past the map's boundaries, causing some enemies to drop chests outside of the game map (bosses in particular).
[*]Projectile Speed and Projectile Range bonuses are now limited to 200%.
[*]Fortune now can slightly affect the amount of cash pickups drop off of enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Performance Fix and Chest Cash Buff (1/19/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Blood decals won't spawn outside of boundaries now, to improve performance when the player is slaughtering huge amounts of enemies.
[*]Chest cash drops buffed more.
[/list]

notes.title: Cash Bonus Small Rework (1/18/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Due to chests being rarer, cash bonuses now have a much higher effect on the amount of cash that drops from Chests.
[*]The Cash Bonus from "Fight in Darkness" has been lowered from $25 to $15, and the Cash Bonus from "Bullet Hell Adjacent" has been lowered from $35 to $25.
[*]Some animation fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: New Music Track; Further Chest Changes; Other Fixes (1/17/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]New Music track "Waltz for the End of the World" has been added as an unlockable. It can be achieved by ending a run with 500+ DPS. 
[*]Chest drops have heavily altered. When players with higher amounts of Upgrades go into lower difficulties, chest drops will be lowered significantly, thus encouraging players to try higher difficulty modes. In general, the high number of chest drops made them not feel as valuable, and felt excessive. I failed to notice this because I mostly tested on the final stage on Difficulty 3, therefore didn't know how many could drop if, say, a player went in with 80+ Upgrades and played on Difficulty 1 or 2.
[*]Fixed some further opacity issues with Ice Meteors.
[*]"You Can Break Me All Night" Black Card now has had its explosion animation changed and is now 150% bigger.
[*]The Demon Drone that randomly appears now has its health scale off of the player's performance, so you may have to chase it.
[*]The Assassin that you can summon from the "Thirsty" card now has health that scales off of the player's performance.
[*]FINALLY fixed the annoying bug that lasted for months where icons from some enemies (Enraged icons, etc) weren't disappearing.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Change to Chest Drops (1/16/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Chests will no longer spawn outside of the game's boundaries. Don't know why this took me so long to address or fix completely.
[*]Chest drops will have diminishing returns on quantity - meaning that if you're getting 1 chest a second basically, they will slow down and be less common the more you collect. This was partially for performance reasons as well as to increase challenge. Some players found  that using fully upgraded characters on lower difficulties were attaining insane levels of damage and destruction thanks to high chest drops.
[*]Fixed small issues with opacity of weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Spidermines buffed (1/15/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes blood would appear over enemy attacks or even over the player's ground based weapons.
[*]Spidermines now have had their damage increased by 50%.
[/list]

notes.title: New Sidekick added (1/10/2025)
notes.content:
To add additional balance and more play options, a new sidekick has been added. Grimetime - whose slight control over time and durations will potentially add life saving seconds to the Second Rates' meaningless lives. All in exchange for giving him access to room temperature showers (hot, if Black Site Bill feels like acting as the team's human boiler). 

After months of thinking on it, Grimetime was added to make characters who rely on taking damage (as well as others, depending on your taste), more viable in late game.

[b]Also other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Weapon opacity is now changeable (this is an old change from last week but failed to make a post about it).
[*]The Stats Box at the top now shows the cooldown of the Super Shield as well as Heath Recovery.
[*]Potentially fixed the issue of unreachable boxes on the boundaries of the map which would cause slowdown issues when there were dozens or 100s of unreachable boxes (this is a work in progress).
[*]Fixed an issue with the text on 'Exaggerated Swagger.'
[*]Potentially fixed an issue with blood appearing over enemy attack indicators and Carpet Demons, making it hard to see them (this is a work in progress).
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes (1/8/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Minor bug fixes involving cards.
[*]Fixed some of the weapon effects that I missed that weren't effected by the opacity slider.
[/list]

notes.title: Party's Over (Exploit fixes) (1/5/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug where the player could exceed 4000% speed and phase through the map's boundaries. While probably lore accurate, it broke the game. Max speed was supposed to be 300% at launch but this was missed just by a typo.
[*]Fixed a bug where Red Card 'Slow Your Flow' (stunning an enemy will reduce its speed by 15%, up to 3 times) could lead bosses having their speed reduced to 0. 
[/list]

notes.title: Red Card Adjustments; Difficulty Tweaks (1/5/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Red Card 'The Final Say' has been significantly nerfed from doing 20 + 4X Global Damage, to 200+ 4X Global Damage.
[*]Red Card 'Who's Cleaning That Up?' (which shot projectiles from a killed elite's corpse) has been nerfed, with its range halved, and its damage down from 2.5% of the enemy's Max HP, to 1%. Previous it was just screen wiping everything, making it boring.
[*]Checker Demons, the scary demons that come if you're doing too well, have had their spawn frequency reduced, but now have 2X as much health and move 15% faster, making them more scary.
[*]Red slimes, a rare Difficulty 3 spawn, now have more health, scaling off the player's power rating, to pose more of a threat.
[*]Brainsnails have more health, scaling off the player's power rating.
[*]Ghost Clumps (large yellow ghosts that shoot double projectiles at the player on Difficulty 3) now have health scaling off the player's power rating.
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty tweaks; Bug Fixes: Enraged Icons + Boss Attacks (1/4/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a potentially game breaking issue where rarely when two bosses of the same attack spawned at once, their attacks wouldn't work. This was particularly evident when the player has a high XP Bonus leading to multiple boss spawns.
[*]Hopefully fixed an issue with stray Enraged Icons not disappearing outside of player boundaries. (Edit: most of them have been fixed but occasionally they will still pop up and this needs to be fixed). 
[*]Enemy scaling for special enemies is now slightly changed to provide a greater challenge to players who are doing well. Heroes now have a scaling, invisible Power Rating that will change depending on how well you're doing, making certain enemies tougher and more damaging.
[/list]

notes.title: Bravera Bug Fix; Burner Phone Nerf (1/2/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Bravera's Jets would disappear once she reached a total of +4 to her Magic Jet count (for a total of 5). Thanks to a player for finding this.
[*]Burner Phone's explosive barrels have been nerfed from giving 20% Crit Damage bonus to 10%, and from +10% Max HP to 5%. It can only be destroyed a total of 10 times now. Previously it became so overpowered that I was able to achieve 300 million damage on one character.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where picking more than 10 Crit Chance increase cards would lead to empty cards showing up.
[*]Chests will generally no longer drop when they're on the boundary of a level, which was leading to slowdown due to unreachable chests.
[/list]

notes.title: Sound Bug Fix / Performance (12/31/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Filthy Artillery's sound played even when sound was turned off.
[*]Small performance fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor End Screen Adjustment; Coronet Fix; Text Fix (12/21/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]XP and Ultimate bar are no longer visible on the end screens.
[*]Background effects have been added to the end screens.
[*]Fixed an issue on the Upgrade screen where text would sometimes overlap the Purchase button due to text wrapping.
[*]Fixed a pretty big issue where the Coronet of Obliteration was not correctly damaging enemies after bouncing, and failing to bounce if the player is too close to a wall.
[/list]

notes.title: Much Fewer Duplicate Cards (12/20/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Due to "popular" demand, duplicate cards have been reduced as best as I could. I put those in there a while ago just to make sure that weapon cards were more common but now I realize it probably doesn't make much of a difference.
[/list]

notes.title: Extrajudicial Memory Leak Fix; 'Long Reach' Card Fix (12/19/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Extrajudicial's Ultimate was creating too many explosions that would cause extreme slowdown.
[*]'Long Reach' Red Card now correctly gives +20% to Melee Size, 20% to Projectile Range and +20% to all Core Weapon damage.
[*]The hitpoints of the barrels from 'Burner Phone' have been brought down.
[/list]

notes.title: New Endgame One-Time Items Added! (12/18/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Additional Purchasable One-Time items have been added to enhance the variety of endgame runs, making it more difficult or easy based on your taste.[/b] If you already have achieved the requirements, you can just trigger them by getting in a run and then ending it to trigger the achievement state, since they are calculated after a run.
[*]'Bulletproof Overpants' which provide you with a shield at start, +100% shield strength, but your shield's cooldown is doubled.
[*]'Mystery Pill' - which adds 75% to a random Damage Type but lowers other damage types by 25%.
[*]'Burner Phone' - which summons explosive barrels periodically that, when destroyed within 15 seconds, reward the player with 1 of 3 random bonuses, and if not, explode for big owch.
[*]'Shrink Ring' - which decreases your size by 40%, increases your speed by 40%, but decreases your Damage Reduction by 40%.
[/list]

Other changes:

[list]
[*]Cooldown Reduction basic cards were mistakenly allowing you to choose them up to 15 times, which is now correctly reduced to 5 times, making it harder to achieve max level Cooldown Reduction.
[*]Brickhead's negative of -20% speed is now correctly listed on his main page, whereas before this was not listed.
[*]Fixed an issue where Blowhole could get past 60% cooldown reduction of his Frigid Wave and Ice Meteors with a Black Card.
[/list]

notes.title: Emergency Crash Fix, Blowhole Buff, 'PhD in Taunting 2' Buff (12/16/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the new card 'Better Off Alone' was causing a crash.
[*]Blowhole's -80% to non-Frost elemental damage has been raised to -60%.
[*]More space has been added on the bottom of the Unlocks page for future additions.
[*]'PhD in Taunting, 2, has had its bonus to Health Recovery and Heal Amount buffed from +50 to +100.
[*]The visibility of the turret placement marker has been increased to help see it in enemy blood.
[*]'It's Like a Movie' card has had an syntax error fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the cursor wouldn't disappear when switching from a targeted Power-up weapon to a non-targeted (invulnerability or Spikeballs).
[*]'Crit out of Luck: Frost's' Manta Ray no longer does AOE damage or scales to AOE size, and only does Frost and Melee damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Controller Aiming Patch (Ults + Pickups) / New Grey Card (12/15/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]When playing on controller, using pickup weapons and ultimates (for certain characters) will now fire in the direction you face the cursor (which is locked around you) rather than the cursor having free movement. This may be buggy in some cases especially when Ultimates are used at the same time as the Pickup weapons - especially on Lady Victory, so please let me know if there are any issues that I missed. (I.e., since there's only one cursor, it's not viable for Lady Victory's Ult attack to be freeform whereas her pickup weapon is not).
[*]New Grey Card 'Better Off Alone' added. This makes it possible to shorten the duration of Taunt for some builds that want Taunt to be on a quicker cooldown.
[*]More space has been made on the Upgrade screen for future One Time Purchasables which I will be adding in the near future.
[*]Brickhead's ultimate attack animations have been slightly improved in terms of shading.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch (12/14/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Abyssal Javelins were not triggering "Crit Out of Luck: Frost". 
[*]The crosshair for pickup weapons and ultimate attacks are slightly bigger and possibly more visible. This is a fix until I figure out a way to make these attacks more viable for controller players.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Enemy Fix (12/12/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Big Ghosts (the clump of heads that appears on Diff 3) now have their projectile speed lowered by 33%. They also only spawn after level 15.
[*]Brainsnails only spawn after level 20.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch (12/8/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Storkstrike Drone wasn't benefiting from Crit Out Of Luck: Electric.
[*]Fixed an issue where Storkstrike Drone wasn't displaying 'Melee' damage in its tooltip.
[/list]

notes.title: Blowhole Buff, Text Fixes, Bug Fixes (12/7/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Blowhole now buffed to receive his healing bonus being increased by 1X the difficulty level. (I.e., instead of +6% Frost Damage on touching an frozen enemy, he receives +18% on Down VERY Bad difficulty, or Difficulty 3).
[*]Hopefully fixed an issue where enemies were getting frozen and not displaying the frozen animation.
[*]Adjusted some of the font to be less blurry but this is a work in progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch and Blowhole slight buff (12/4/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Storkstrike Drone appearing over dialogue.
[*]End panel should have said 'Super Weapons Equipped' rather than 'Unique Weapons Equipped.'
[*]Storkstrike Drone's tooltip should properly factor in Melee Damage bonuses.
[*](Hopefully) fixed a rare bug where Brick Fist's upgrade card would be an empty error when the player had 5 (max) Fists.
[*]Blowhole now heals himself for 35% of his Freeze Damage + Heal Amount, up from 35% of his Freeze Damage. This was to make him more viable in harder difficulties.
[/list]

notes.title: Red Card 'Wrong Genre' Buff (12/1/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]'Wrong Genre' is now buffed to have a 5% chance to shoot rockets. Damage increased from 200% of Turrets' base damage to 250%.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Fixes and New Achievement (11/24/2024)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Knockback Chance can no longer go over 100%.

notes.title: Minor patch on Cash drop rates
notes.content:
Cash drop rates have been increased by 300%. Later on in game cash becomes extremely plentiful and the game was designed to be a challenge to build up to the final levels of power, but I can understand how that can be frustrating. I figured it'd be offset by the number of heroes and combinations to increase replayability and challenge, so even with the increased cash drops I don't want players to be able to shoot to end game just like that.

If people still are upset I can continue to raise them until it feels right.
